prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent side-view fantasy platformer traversal prop, normalized later to a 256×1024 runtime PNG
Primary request: create one single straight ruined-fantasy climbing ladder that belongs in the supplied moonlit overgrown ancient-ruins game world
Input images: Image 1 is the approved tileset style and palette reference; Image 2 is the approved environment concept style, material, lighting, and world reference
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent canvas only
Subject: one tall front-facing ladder, exactly two parallel weathered dark wooden rails reinforced with subtle chipped ancient-metal bindings, and exactly eight visually distinct horizontal wooden rungs spanning rail-to-rail; restrained moss and tiny teal vine wraps may hug the rails but must not form separate silhouettes
Style/medium: original hand-painted fantasy game sprite/cutout, crisp painterly edges and surface texture, visually cohesive with the references, readable at small gameplay scale
Composition/framing: orthographic straight-on side elevation, ladder centered, vertical, symmetrical, nearly full image height, generous transparent clearance on every outer edge; all rungs horizontal and evenly spaced; no perspective taper, no skew
Lighting/mood: cool moonlit cyan rim highlights over deep teal and dark brown, high-enough contrast for gameplay readability
Color palette: dark weathered wood, midnight teal, muted jade moss, pale cyan edge accents, tiny restrained warm-metal highlights
Materials/textures: worn wooden rails and rungs, chipped bindings, light moss; solid connected climbable construction
Constraints: actual transparent background and clean nontrivial alpha; exactly one ladder; exactly two rails; exactly eight rungs; no ground contact slab; no shadow; no background; no surrounding foliage; no detached fragments; no text; no logos; no watermark; no border; no panels
Avoid: rope ladder, stone staircase, perspective view, diagonal rails, uneven spacing, missing or extra rungs, characters, enemies, UI, checkerboard, white or black background, photorealism, 3D render, pixel art
